verdicts.evidence: The light teal panel at top right (about x 676–1076, y 110–410) holds only two empty speech-bubble outlines, and the line "Say it back and get feedback on each word" appears only in step 2 below.
Directly under the orange CTA sits a grey rounded box headed "Keep your streak going" with the text "Learners who practice five days in a row finish the course twice as often."

The steps run in thirds from x 56 to 1224, while the illustration panel spans about x 676–1076 and ends about 150 px short of where "Log in" and step 3 end; its bottom edge (~410) lines up with neither the button (~362) nor the card (~498).

The quoted phrases "Start your free week", "Short daily lessons", "a tutor that listens" and "Finish with a short chat about your day" all appear, and nothing nearby gives card, price, duration or chat-partner details.
